Haa Meem
Is kitaab ki tanzeel us Khuda ki taraf se hai jo saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai
Beshak aasmaanon aur zameenon mein saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Aur khud tumhaari khilqat mein bhi, aur jin jaanwaron ko woh phailaata rehta hai un mein bhi saahibaan-e-yaqeen ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan hain

Aur raat din ki raft o aamad mein, aur jo rizq Khuda ne aasmaan se naazil kiya hai jis ke zariye se murda zameenon ko zinda banaaya hai, aur hawaaon ke chalne mein us qaum ke liye nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain jo aql rakhne waali hai
Yeh Allah ki aayatein hain jin ki haq ke saath tilaawat ki ja rahi hai, to Allah aur us ki aayaton ke baad yeh kis baat par imaan laane waale hain
Beshak har jhoote gunahgaar ke haal par afsos hai
Jo tilaawat ki jaane waali aayaat ko sunta hai aur phir akad jaata hai jaise suna hi nahin hai, to use dardnaak azaab ki bashaarat de dijiye
Aur use jab bhi hamaari kisi nishaani ka ilm hota hai to us ka mazaaq udaata hai. Beshak yahi woh log hain jin ke liye ruswa-kun azaab hai
Un ke peechhe Jahannam hai, aur unhon ne jo kuch kamaaya hai aur jin logon ko Khuda ko chhod kar sarparast banaaya hai koi kaam aane waala nahin hai, aur un ke liye bahut bada azaab hai
Yeh Quran ek hidaayat hai, aur jin logon ne aayaat-e-Khuda ka inkaar kiya hai un ke liye sakht qism ka dardnaak azaab hoga
Allah hi ne tumhaare liye darya ko musakhkhar kiya hai ke us ke hukm se kashtiyaan chal sakein aur tum us ke fazl o karam ko talaash kar sako, aur shaayad us ka shukriya bhi ada kar sako
Aur usi ne tumhaare liye zameen o aasmaan ki tamaam cheezon ko musakhkhar kar diya hai. Beshak is mein ghaur o fikr karne waali qaum ke liye nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Aap saahibaan-e-imaan se keh dein ke woh Khudaai dinon ki tawaqqo na rakhne waalon se darguzar karein, taake Khuda qaum ko un ke aamaal ka mukammal badla de sake
Jo nek kaam karega woh apne faaide ke liye karega, aur jo buraai karega woh apne hi nuqsaan ke liye karega. Us ke baad tum sab Parwardigar ki taraf palataaye jaaoge
Aur yaqeenan hum ne Bani Israaeel ko kitaab, hukoomat aur nubuwwat ata ki hai, aur inhein paakeeza rizq diya hai, aur inhein tamaam aalameen par fazeelat di hai

Aur inhein apne amr ki khuli hui nishaaniyaan ata ki hain. Phir un logon ne ilm aane ke baad aapas ki zidd mein ikhtilaaf kiya, to yaqeenan tumhaara Parwardigar roz-e-qiyaamat un ke darmiyaan un tamaam baaton ka faisla kar dega jin mein yeh ikhtilaaf karte rahe hain
Phir hum ne aap ko apne hukm ke waazeh raaste par laga diya, lihaaza aap usi ka ittibaa' karein aur khabardaar jaahilon ki khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' na karein
Yeh log Khuda ke muqaable mein zarra baraabar kaam aane waale nahin hain, aur zaalimeen aapas mein ek doosre ke dost hain, to Allah saahibaan-e-taqwa ka sarparast hai
Yeh logon ke liye raushni ka majmooa aur yaqeen karne waali qaum ke liye hidaayat aur rehmat hai

Kya buraai ikhtiyaar kar lene waalon ne yeh khayaal kar liya hai ke hum inhein imaan laane waalon aur nek amal karne waalon ke baraabar qaraar de denge, ke sab ki maut o hayaat ek jaisi ho? Yeh un logon ne nihaayat badtareen faisla kiya hai
Aur Allah ne aasmaan o zameen ko haq ke saath paida kiya hai, aur is liye bhi ke har nafs ko us ke aamaal ka badla diya ja sake, aur yahaan kisi par zulm nahin kiya jaaega

Kya aap ne us shakhs ko bhi dekha hai jis ne apni khwaahish hi ko khuda bana liya hai, aur Khuda ne usi haalat ko dekh kar use gumraahi mein chhod diya hai, aur us ke kaan aur dil par mohr laga di hai, aur us ki aankh par parde pade hue hain. Aur Khuda ke baad kaun hidaayat kar sakta hai? Kya tum itna bhi ghaur nahin karte ho

Aur yeh log kehte hain ke yeh sirf zindagaani-e-duniya hai, isi mein marte hain aur jeete hain, aur zamaana hi hum ko halaak kar deta hai. Aur inhein is baat ka koi ilm nahin hai, yeh sirf un ke khayaalaat hain aur bas
Aur jab un ke saamne hamaari khuli hui aayaat ki tilaawat hoti hai to un ki daleel sirf yeh hoti hai ke agar tum sachche ho to hamaare baap daada ko zinda kar ke le aao

Aap keh dijiye ke Khuda hi tum ko bhi zinda rakhe hai, phir ek din maut dega, aur aakhir mein sab ko roz-e-qiyaamat jama karega jis mein koi shak nahin hai, lekin aksar log is baat ko bhi nahin samajhte hain
Aur Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ka mulk hai, aur jis din qiyaamat qaaim hogi us din ahl-e-baatil ko waaqai khasaara hoga
Aur aap har qaum ko ghutne ke bal baitha hua dekhenge, aur sab ko un ke naama-e-aamaal ki taraf bulaaya jaaega ke aaj tumhein tumhaare aamaal ka badla diya jaaega
Yeh hamaari kitaab (naama-e-aamaal) hai jo haq ke saath bolti hai, aur hum us mein tumhaare aamaal ko baraabar likhwa rahe the
Ab jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye inhein Parwardigar apni rehmat mein daakhil kar lega, ke yahi sab se numaayaan kaamyaabi hai
Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya (un se kaha jaaega) to kya tumhaare saamne hamaari aayaat ki tilaawat nahin ho rahi thi? Lekin tum ne akad se kaam liya aur beshak tum ek mujrim qaum the

Aur jab yeh kaha gaya ke Allah ka waada sachcha hai aur qiyaamat mein koi shak nahin hai, to tum ne keh diya ke hum to qiyaamat nahin jaante hain, hum use ek khayaali baat samajhte hain aur hum us ka yaqeen karne waale nahin hain
Aur un ke liye un ke aamaal ki buraaiyaan saabit ho gayin, aur inhein usi azaab ne gher liya jis ka woh mazaaq udaaya karte the

Aur un se kaha gaya ke hum tumhein aaj isi tarah nazar-andaaz kar denge jis tarah tum ne aaj ke din ki mulaaqaat ko bhula diya tha, aur tum sab ka anjaam Jahannam hai aur tumhaara koi madadgaar nahin hai

Yeh sab is liye hai ke tum ne aayaat-e-Ilaahi ka mazaaq banaaya tha aur tumhein zindagaani-e-duniya ne dhoke mein rakha tha. To aaj yeh log azaab se baahar nahin nikaale jaayenge aur inhein maafi maangne ka mauqa bhi nahin diya jaaega
Saari hamd usi Khuda ke liye hai jo aasmaan o zameen aur tamaam aalameen ka Parwardigar aur maalik hai
Usi ke liye aasmaan o zameen mein buzurgi aur kibriyaai hai, aur wahi saahib-e-izzat aur hikmat waala hai
